name: North Pacific Bank,Ltd.
summary: North Pacific Bank,Ltd. provides various banking products and services for individuals and corporations in Japan. The company offers savings, foreign currency, and time deposits; financial product and online financial product intermediation; government and public bonds for individuals; fund wrap; and investment trusts. It also provides home, car, education, home renovation, card, and personal loans; insurance and online insurance products; inheritance and trust related products; deposits for educational donations; and defined contribution pension.
